name: @transferkit/cli
description: Local-first CLI for engineering handover and onboarding workflows
author: Ali Alaraby

scripts.bundle: node -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --external:ts-morph --outfile=dist/index.js && node -e "import { chmodSync } from 'node:fs'; chmodSync('dist/index.js', 0o755)"
